{{onesource|date=April 2010}}
In [[cryptography]], '''ABC''' is a [[stream cipher|stream cypher]] [[algorithm]] developed by [[Vladimir Anashin]], [[Andrei Bogdanov (cryptographer)|Andrey Bogdanov]], [[Ilya Kizhvatov]], and [[Sandeep Kumar (cryptographer)|Sandeep Kumar]].<ref name="ABCspec">{{cite journal|last1=Anashin|first1=Vladimir|last2=Bogdanov|first2=Andrey|last3=Andrey|first3=Ilya|title=ABC: A New Fast Flexible Stream Cipher|journal=[[ECRYPT|European Network of Excellence in Cryptology II]]|url=http://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/ciphers/abc/abc.pdf|accessdate=26 January 2015|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20061011134727/http://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/ciphers/abc/abc.pdf|archive-date=2006-10-11}}</ref> It has been submitted to the [[eSTREAM]] Project of the [[eCRYPT]] network.

It takes a 128-bit key and a 128-bit [[Initialization vector|IV]].<ref name="ABCspec" />

The claimed security level of <math>2^{128}</math> bits has been reduced to <math>2^{88}</math>.<ref>{{cite book | last1=Falahati | first1=Aboifazl | last2=Bagheri | first2=Nasoor | last3=Naderi | first3=Majid | last4=Mohajeri | first4=Javad | title=A new distinguish attack against ABC stream cipher | date=May 7, 2007 | pages=1768–1770 | doi=10.1109/ICACT.2007.358713 | isbn=978-89-5519-131-8 }}</ref>
